requirement_text.REQ-002: Replace every placeholder in messages/uz.json with real Uzbek translations. 4 acceptance criteria: (1) every key has a non-empty, non-placeholder value except verified standalone domain-vocabulary/proper-noun exceptions; (2) no Cyrillic anywhere in messages/uz.json; (3) status-label values correct per the CSS-driven uppercase convention; (4) no exclamation marks, slogans, or emoji.

task.description: Independently re-verify REQ-002 per WF-02 Step 5 -- do not trust TEST-RUNNER's report alone. This run already went through one rework cycle (REVIEWER caught a garbled translation, CONTENT-BA fixed it, REVIEWER re-verified) and TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR independently re-judged all 21 identical-value pairs as legitimate exceptions -- you should still do your own independent pass, not lean on those prior checks alone. (1) Re-run npm run lint && npm run build yourself. (2) Re-run the Cyrillic scan and the 21-identical-value-pair check yourself, and spot-check at least 5-8 of the ACTUAL TRANSLATED (non-identical) values yourself for basic sanity (does it read as real Uzbek prose, not garbled text) -- pick different keys than what REVIEWER/TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR already checked if you can tell from their handoffs which ones those were. (3) Start the server yourself and curl at least 2-3 rendered pages/sections. (4) Confirm all 4 acceptance criteria against actual current code/output. (5) Check docs/agents/requirements.yaml's REQ-002 entry for staleness -- does it still accurately describe what shipped?
acceptance_criteria: npm run lint && npm run build re-run independently, real output quoted
Cyrillic scan and identical-value-pair check re-run with own commands
5-8 NEW (not previously spot-checked) translated values read for basic sanity
Server started, 2-3 rendered pages curled independently
